36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
133333: Kazuya Souma is the main male protagonist of Genjitsu Shugi Yuusha no Oukoku Saikenki series.
133334: Daughter of the Chief of the Dark Elves of the God Protected Forest. One of the 5 people discovered during the gathering of Gifted People after winning the Martial Competition.
133335: Hakuya Kwonmin is a recurring character of Genjitsu Shugi Yuusha no Oukoku Saikenki series. He is currently the Prime Minister of the Kingdom of Freidonia.
133336: Liscia Elfrieden is the main female protagonist of Genjitsu Shugi Yuusha no Oukoku Saikenki series. She was the princess of Elfrieden, the daughter of the previous king, Albert Elfrieden, and the first primary queen of Freidonia as the tentative fiancée of Souma.
133337: Juna Doma is one of the female protagonist of Genjitsu Shugi Yuusha no Oukoku Saikenki series. She is the granddaughter of Excel Walter.
133338: Tomoe Inui is a recurring character of Genjitsu Shugi Yuusha no Oukoku Saikenki series.
133339: Elisha Elfrieden is a character of Genjitsu Shugi Yuusha no Oukoku Saikenki series. She was the actual successor to the throne of Elfrieden Kingdom, being the last surviving member of the Elfrieden Royal through the Succession Crisis after the death of the 12th King of Elfrieden.
133340: Jeanne Euphoria is a recurring character of Genjitsu Shugi Yuusha no Oukoku Saikenki series. She is the crown princess and commander of the military of the Gran Chaos Empire as well the younger sister of the current Empress Maria Euphoria.
133341: Georg Carmine is a character of Genjitsu Shugi Yuusha no Oukoku Saikenki series. He was the duke and leader of Elfrieden's Land Army prior to the One Week War.
133342: Roroa Amidonia is one of the female protagonist of Genjitsu Shugi Yuusha no Oukoku Saikenki series. She is the daughter of Gaius Amidonia and the younger sister of Julius Amidonia.
214655: She is the daughter of Castor Vargas, granddaughter of Excel Walter, and friend to Liscia Elfrieden. She was formally the second-in-command to the Air Force of the Vargas Duchy and is currently a slave/maid to Kazuya Souma and Liscia.
214660: She is the grandmother of Carla Vargas and Juna Doma as well as mother-in-law to Castor Vargas, who was formerly the commander of the Air Force. She is currently the supreme commander of the National Defense Force.
218413: She is the older sister to Jeanne Euphoria. She is the current Empress of the Gran Chaos Empire and the first female to rule the empire.
237297: Julius Amidonia, later renamed as Julius Lastania, is the exiled, unofficial ruler of Amidonia before its annex. He is the son of the late Gaius Amidonia and older brother of Roroa Amidonia. Later on, he marries into the Royal Family of Lastania and adopts their surname.
237299: Albert is the former king of Elfrieden and thus has some knowledge of high level government secrets. Albert is kind and caring but indecisive and weak as a leader.
237300: Beowulf is the 2nd-in-command to Georg Carmine in the Elfrieden Army.
237301: Ludwin is a intelligent and charismatic nobleman. As a distinguished knight, he is the leader the Royal Guard when Kazuya first meets him. Though he is of the nobility of Elfrieden, he lives a simplistic lifestyle so that he could financially care for his childhood friend.
237302: The head priest under Albert Elfrieden, who summoned Kazuya Souma.
237304: He was the former Prime Minister of the Elfrieden Kingdom before being replaced by Hakuya Kwonmin and now serves as the chamberlain for the former rulers, Albert Elfrieden and Elisha Elfrieden.
240243: Kaede is a caring and thoughtful individual, especially towards Halbert. Unlike Halbert, she is capable of seeing through a situation before taking action, often foreseeing the outcome ahead of time.
242046: The grandfather of Kazuya who gave his final words to his grandson before his death
246567: Halbert is the son of Glaive Magna and childhood friend of Kaede Foxia. Originally, Halbert was hot-headed and naïve, but he later begins to respect the hero-turned-king for his methods, innovations, and especially the new foods that were introduced.
246568: Glaive Magna is a stern and disciplined man who is loyal to the kingdom. He is the father of Halbert.
246569: Colbert was the Finance Minister of Amidonia and is currently the Finance Minister of Friedonia. He is seen as shy and easily intimidated. He does have a good deal of common sense, though he seems lacking in confidence.
246570: Chief of the Dark Elves in the God-Protected Forest, brother to Robthor Udgard and the father to Aisha Udgard.
246571: Sebastian is the proprietor of the men's clothing store "The Silver Deer." He is also a good friend of Roroa Amidonia. Like Roroa, Sebastian has a good sense of economics and business. He is also very good at collecting information.
247727: Serina is the current Head Maid of the of the Parnam Castle and Liscia's personal attendant.
277885: Genia is reclusive, but is quite personable. She is capable of maintaining normal conversations, even when others dismiss her ideas as crazy. This is most noticeable in her interactions with Kazuya, Ludwin, and her newfound researcher colleagues.
